name: Chipo's Braids & Beauty
tagline: Unhurried braids, nails and hair care in Kabulonga.

categories.name: Braids
categories.blurb: Long sittings. Only times that fit the full braid are shown.

services.name: Knotless braids, medium
services.description: Lightweight braids with no knot at the scalp, finished simply and comfortably.

services.name: Knotless braids, small
services.description: A fuller small size. Needs a five-hour stretch without crossing the lunch break.

services.name: Knotless braids, jumbo
services.description: The fullest size, about six hours. It only fits on Wednesday, when there is no lunch break.

services.name: Cornrows
services.description: Neat feed-in rows, sized for a two-hour appointment.

services.name: Braids takedown
services.description: Gentle removal, detangle and a simple scalp cleanse.

categories.name: Nails
categories.blurb: Gel colour and care with Tasha.

services.name: Gel manicure
services.description: Shape, cuticle care and a gel colour that cures before you leave.

services.name: Classic pedicure
services.description: Soak, tidy and colour for a one-hour visit.

categories.name: Lashes
categories.blurb: Sets and fills. Plan for a still hour or two.

services.name: Classic lash set
services.description: A full classic set, one lash at a time, with aftercare notes.

services.name: Lash fill
services.description: A refill for a set that is two to three weeks old.

categories.name: Hair care
categories.blurb: Washes, trims and silk presses with Lombe.

services.name: Wash, condition and trim
services.description: A careful wash, deep condition and dusting of the ends.

services.name: Silk press
services.description: Wash, treatment and a smooth press. Ends are not cut unless you ask.
